description: A normal binary tree below a countable nonzero limit has a countable nonempty new level extending every old node and, when prescribed, meeting a maximal antichain.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.countable_limit_extension (S A : Set Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.BinaryNode)
  (δ : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.OmegaOne) (hδ : Order.IsSuccLimit δ)
  (hS : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.IsNormalBelow S δ)
  (hA : A = ∅ ∨ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.IsMaxAntichainIn S A) :
  ∃ L,
    L.Countable ∧
      L.Nonempty ∧
        (∀ t ∈ L,
            ∃ (ht : t.fst = δ),
              ∀ (β : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DiamondSuslin.OmegaOne) (h : β < δ),
                Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.restrictNode t β ⋯ ∈ S) ∧
          (∀ s ∈ S, ∃ t ∈ L, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.Extends s t) ∧
            ∀ t ∈ L, A ≠ ∅ → ∃ a ∈ A, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.Extends a t
